title: Energy Assistance Desk Note: Pledges and the Late-Charged Amount of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule Bill
content:
An energy assistance pledge recorded on an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account reduces the late-charged amount of the bill when the latest pledge on the account meets two dates. The rule reads only the **latest** energy assistance pledge recorded on the service account, and the payments from that same pledging agency.

**The two dates.** The latest pledge meets them when it was recorded:

- no more than the schedule's pledge hold days — 30 calendar days on all seven schedules — before the current date; and
- on or before the bill's due date, which is the bill date of the bill's facility charge line plus the schedule's bill due days (20 calendar days, or 15 on Schedule GS-3 and Schedule LP).

**The deduction.**

| Latest pledge meets both dates | Payments from the pledging agency dated less than one whole month before the current date | Deducted from the late-charged amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | None | The full pledged amount |
| Yes | One or more | The pledged amount less those agency payments, never less than zero |
| No | Any | Nothing |

The deduction comes off the late-charged amount, which itself is never less than zero.

### Hypothetical cases (Schedule R, bill dated March 2, due March 22, current date March 28)

| Latest pledge | Agency payments in the month | Deduction |
|---|---|---|
| $150.00 recorded March 20 | None | $150.00 |
| $150.00 recorded March 20 | $100.00 from the same agency | $50.00 |
| $150.00 recorded March 20 | $180.00 from the same agency | $0.00 |
| $150.00 recorded March 24 | None | Nothing — recorded after the due date |
| $150.00 recorded February 20 | None | Nothing — recorded more than 30 calendar days before March 28 |

### Points of reading

- An older pledge is not read when a later pledge exists on the account, even if the older one would have met the dates.
- Payments from a different agency do not reduce the pledged amount deducted.
